peerGroup.rule: same class (ec), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 11.1% above its local comparables; 33 of 37 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (65.2): 6.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 29 of 46 similar developments (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 87.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (ec), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,388,000 ($1,675 psf, 828 sq ft; 11 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,538 psf (range $1,311–1,621); 8.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $114,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,910,888 ($1,788 psf, 1,001–1,162 sq ft; 17 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,580 psf (range $1,401–1,939); 13.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $222,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Buangkok MRT about 240 m, Renjong LRT about 550 m; closer than 41 of 46 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 5 within 1 km and 16 within 2 km; nearest Palm View Primary School about 210 m; more than 42 of 46 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 250 m), more than 18 of 46 similar developments (the same as 14); nearest hawker centre Buangkok Hawker Centre about 190 m; nearest park Punggol Park about 720 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other EC development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 39 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 965 resales (965 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (40) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Hougang Central (government land sale site, awarded, about 830 homes), about 1,090 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 965 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 46 of 46 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 965 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 990 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−2.5%). Planning-area private resales −10%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
